package.title: Linux (GEMix)
requires: 64-bit x86 Linux with glibc 2.35 or newer.
A running GEMix `gemd` server. Blaise is a GEM client and connects to the server named by `GEMD_SOCKET`; it does not start one.
No TLS: this build refuses accounts that ask for it (see the project's docs/notes/TLS.md).

package.title: Windows
requires: 64-bit Windows 10 or 11.
[Windows App Runtime 1.8 (x64)](https://learn.microsoft.com/windows/apps/windows-app-sdk/downloads). Install it once; Blaise will not start without it.
No TLS: this build refuses accounts that ask for it (see the project's docs/notes/TLS.md).
run: Unzip the folder and run `blaise.exe`. Keep the DLLs beside it.
